text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Zimbabwean capital Harare's municipal council will borrow Z$100 million from the local money market to finance several capital projects being held up by lack of funding.

- More than 90,000 Zimbabweans who entered South Africa between January 1995 and last July on six-month visas have not returned, prompting South Africa authorities to introduce a stricter visa applicatin screening system.
- The state-owned Cold Storage Company's beef exports to Europe have been depressed during the first six months of the year with earnings dropping by over 40 percent.
